pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition on adding to losing positions; multi-ticket scaling only permitted when trade 1 is in +$10.00 profit with stop-loss moved to breakeven + commissions.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero order execution allowed within 15 minutes of high-impact macro news windows, requiring 3-period ATR expansion and volume confirmation.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% of volume at +$10.00, trail remainder with a tighter ATR step to guarantee the $15-$30+ win target.
